about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers diagnostics and engine work, tires and wheels. We work out of Dillon and the towns around it.

reviews.author: kevin byrdf ft
reviews.text: My family (wife, 3 daughters, and granddaughter) were stranded in the side of 95 with a flat tire. I was 2 hours away. Fred’s came after hours to remove the tire, take it back to the shop, mount a new tire, and bring it back and install. Thank you so much!! The Byrds

reviews.author: Robin McClellan
reviews.text: I'm always at Fred's for something with my vehicles. They never disappoint. I love the guys that work there along with the owner. Miss my Saturday mornings but I totally understand the hassle. I love the fact you can watch them do things so you know it's being done unlike dealerships who will charge you and not even do the job. Fred's is the place to go.

reviews.author: Ashley Gregori
reviews.text: Fred's Tires and Auto to the rescue! Traveling 12 hours from Northern Virginia to Disney and my tire picked up something. I was in and out within 20 minutes, polite, quick, and great price on a new tire! Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Jennifer Vinkler
reviews.text: Arrived at 4:45 with a flat tire I got on the highway. By 5:15 we were back on the road. Exceptional service and very accommodating. Even got an explanation of what went wrong with the original tire on my car. Couldn’t ask for more. Thank you.

reviews.author: Arthur Davies
reviews.text: Towing my RV home from Fl to MA and saw pressure drop in one of my rear tires. Pulled off 95 and found Fred’s Tire. Pulled in and they took me right away, located a small piece of steel in the tread, had me patched up and on my way in about 20 minutes. Awesome, friendly, professional service. They were busy with many other customers but got me right back on the road.

reviews.author: Veronica Bland
reviews.text: Fred’s came in on a clutch. We were sitting on the side of the road traveling from NC back to Georgia and had a blow out. Called Fred he was ready and waiting to help. He had us in and out in no time with a a practically new tire. The customer service was immaculate. I highly recommended them for your tire service needs

reviews.author: molly bacon
reviews.text: Traveling on 95 and discovered we had a bad water pump. Called Fred’s right at opening and they fit us into their schedule same day. We were back on the road by noon! Can’t thank them enough. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jimmy King
reviews.text: Fred provides great service with fair prices. No pressure, no upselling, just solid work done right. Highly recommend

reviews.author: iloveeventing1
reviews.text: Two flat trailer tires on I 95. It was cold, wet, raining and Super Bowl Sunday. When nobody else seem to care Fred stepped up came out did a great job got me back on the road and was very reasonable on the price. Very grateful great job and appreciate his efforts .

reviews.author: Kerri Lupton
reviews.text: Fred's Tire & Auto Repair is your only Choice in Dillon. The best price and service you can ask for. If you're using anyone else you are overpaying and not receiving the service you would get at this business

reviews.author: Mike Martin
reviews.text: Overall, I find Fred’s to be excellent service fair pricing. That being said there was a time when Fred was open on Saturdays this was convenient for those who work Monday through Friday. I could not make a trip during the week due to the distance of work and such. Now that he is closed on Saturdays I’m finding myself looking for somewhere else to take my vehicle. Honestly, this is something I do not in anywhere appreciate. I do recognize that people need days off during the week but for the automotive shop Saturday is one of their prime days of business. Nevertheless, I’ll have to start going somewhere else not because I want to because Fred’s is no longer open on Saturdays.

reviews.author: Holly Hayes
reviews.text: Had a flat late Saturday afternoon in Dillon County and called around to different places in search of someone who could find us a replacement. With a lot of people not having the tire in stock, Fred’s was able to find us one!! Contacted Fred and within minutes he was able to tell me he could help and he could do it right then (late Saturday night) so that we could be on the road early Sunday morning back to Columbia. I don’t know of many people who are willing to help on such short notice but Fred was. Couldn’t recommend him or his business enough. THANK YOU!!

reviews.author: Homer Thompson
reviews.text: Honest people, fair pricing, and great craftsmanship. Fred has always taken care of my family. You don't have to worry about shady craftsmanship with this guy he is very honest and stands behind his work.

reviews.author: Tegan Rogers
reviews.text: Always can rely on them to get my car in and out fast. Great prices and always able to trust their work.

reviews.author: Jason Tucker
reviews.text: Fred is amazing! We were traveling from FL to NC and had 3 tires go bad simultaneously. Fred saved the day late on a Friday night. He stayed late and made sure we were good to continue on our trip. Amazing service and very good prices. Thanks Fred! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Tammy Ross
reviews.text: I will never use any business other than Fred's. The quality of professionalism is top notch. I took my car in and asked him to look it over and let me know what it needed. He was VERY honest and did not do anything unnecessary. I even asked if it needed a list of things and he told me no they were fine. The customer service is excellent. The owner Fred is very helpful and interacts with his customers. I highly recommend this business.

reviews.author: Selena Shelley
reviews.text: This is the best place ever. Fred is a very honest and trustworthy person. He believes in taking care of his clients. He’s very straight forward. He won’t jack prices just because. I have my family coming to him. From Marion and Florence. Where else especially a female can come and get top notch service and not being taken advantage of. Fred’s Tire & Auto Repair is the place to go. You won’t go wrong with Fred

reviews.author: Sommer Turner
reviews.text: I had the best experience at Fred’s Tire & Auto Repair! Kevin F. left the shop to come meet me when I had car trouble. He was able to determine that my starter had gone bad within a few minutes. He helped me get it cranked and make it to the shop. Fred P., Kevin F, Daquan M., and other mechanics stayed after hours to ensure I wouldn’t be without my car overnight. They replaced my starter and I was on my way in 30 minutes or less! Impeccable service and skills, and you can trust that your repairs have been done right! I highly recommend Fred’s Tire & Auto for your maintenance/repair needs!

reviews.author: Teria Manning
reviews.text: Had power steering pump and rack and pinion replaced and his prices are very reasonable. They stay busy so it maybe a wait time, but would definitely recommend

reviews.author: Walter Walla
reviews.text: Ford Explorer, Warning light Airpressure was on, checkt all tires - looks ok for me! Visit Fred, short waiting, fast check, Nail in Right Back Tire - Repair was fast, Price was fair! Thx to Fred and his Team

reviews.author: David Cook
reviews.text: Well deserved rating. We had a tire start going bad on a long trip back home to south Ga. Fred's guys were friendly and replaced the tire quickly. Couldn't have been a better experience. Thanks!

reviews.author: Carol Pease
reviews.text: Tire bearing went out on 95. Locals said that Fred’s was the best place for repair. I dropped it off Monday morning and fixed Tuesday afternoon and I was on my way to Florida in no time. They were very busy and still had time to be courteous and patient with me.

reviews.author: Summit Solutions
reviews.text: I was in need of some new tires for my RV after a blowout on the way home from the beach. Within 30 minutes of calling, Fred’s tire was there and working on it. Whole process was pretty quick and the price was very reasonable. Thanks for the help getting me back on the road home within two hours from being stranded. Great service!

reviews.author: Melanie Smith
reviews.text: Needed assistance immediately due to being broke down at a truck stop. Went in and I can't say enough good things about the guys at Fred's Tire and Auto Repair. They got me going in less than 30 minutes. Thank you very much...Smith Family

reviews.author: Bradley Small
reviews.text: Fred and his team at Fred’s Tire Service have always provided their services fast, friendly, and affordable. They have helped with tire patches, tire replacements, brakes, and mechanical issues. I’ve literally watched this team work nights and weekends helping travelers on I-95. 10 out of 10 highly recommend.

reviews.author: Tammy S. Powers
reviews.text: Go check Fred and his crew out for all your vehicle needs. If you are looking for excellent customer service and great quality work, at an affordable price.... Fred's Tire & Auto Repair is the place you want to go to. Highly recommend! Best of the Pee Dee!!

reviews.author: Patrick Eaddy
reviews.text: This place is awesome. If you in the surrounding areas, whether you out of town, or visiting. You need your car fix, this is the number 1 place in Dillon to get your car fix. Fred is an awesome man, may God bless him. Don't forget the mechanics, they are working to get you in and out.

reviews.author: chris huth
reviews.text: Fred’s tire is very dependable. The owner is hands on and very attentive to the needs of his customers. I highly recommend Fred’s Tire And Auto above everyone else. The customer service and the excellent work they do alone is hands down the best in Dillon and most any other place I would imagine.

reviews.author: Michael Devereaux
reviews.text: Broke down on I95. Towed my truck to Fred's Tire and Auto and owner showed up after hours to schedule my service next morning. They diagnosed and got it running right away. I was worried about all the tools in my truck but everything was as I left it. Very honest folks. Great service!

reviews.author: Duncan Callahan
reviews.text: A variety of complications from multiple vehicles have plagued my family and I. However, Fred’s was able to resolve the issues with speed and efficiency. Not only did Fred’s resolve issues, but did so for a great price! Highly recommendable to friends.

reviews.author: Samantha Belanger
reviews.text: Thank you Fred! On our way to Florida from New Hampshire towing a massive boat, blew a tire on the trailer. Spoke with Fred he came out as soon as he finished up with another customer. Very hospitable!!!! Excellent pricing, I recommend calling Fred's Tire & Auto Repair.

reviews.author: Ronald Smith
reviews.text: I highly recommend this place if you want great quality work at an affordable price. The whole auto team is super friendly and professional. If your vehicle ever needs some TLC, then take it to Fred's where they'll treat your wheels like the own.

reviews.author: Jonat Chavarria
reviews.text: Terrible Customer Service, I came a week prior from today needing maintenance work and freon refill, he told me to come the Tuesday of the following week at 9am. I came in today earlier than 9 to make sure they all had time, and the response was “I don’t know maybe I can do it tomorrow”! Shows lack of professionalism and communication. Will not service my car here no more as this has not been the first instance we had to reschedule something several times. Second time coming because I believe in giving businesses second chances but it has crossed the line!

reviews.author: Kim Kugler
reviews.text: You can tell that everyone there, works well together, just like a family. Pleasant place to go, great prices. We are lucky to have hin in Dillon!! I recommend him to everyone!!

reviews.author: Stacy Hargrove
reviews.text: Fred is an awesome guy… always comes when he is called. Best prices- great service! He is our only “go to” guy for all automotive and tire needs!

reviews.author: Patsy King
reviews.text: An excellent place. The only place I take my car. Customer service is excellent. Fred has always been fair and never steered me wrong. The only place I trust.

reviews.author: Thea Williamson
reviews.text: We had a tire blow out during holiday travel south on 95, they took care of us right away and we were back on the road in an hour! Super friendly and fast service.

reviews.author: Aaron Alderman
reviews.text: Fred is wonderful. He does great work for an incredible price, especially considering today’s world. Thanks so much Fred!

reviews.author: Sydni Grooms
reviews.text: Best of the best service! Fred and his team are efficient and reliable! I only trust them and would recommend my friends and family to them for any service they offer.

reviews.author: JK Schwehm
reviews.text: Had tire issue going from Louisiana to Delaware got off exit found Fred's. He had me repaired and back on highway in 30mts for reasonable fee.

reviews.author: Russell Williams
reviews.text: Always had good honest service from Fred and his team. Would recommend him for your services as well. Doubt you will be anything but impressed.

reviews.author: Jeanne Hanson
reviews.text: Cannot say enough about how impressed my husband and i were when we were getting a couple new tires at Fred's. Highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Raven Smith
reviews.text: Fred is the absolute BEST!!! Him and his team always take GREAT care of me. I will ALWAYS recommend him.

reviews.author: Pamela Mccormick
reviews.text: Fred and his crew have always been great to work with. They are extremely professional and kind. I highly recommend!!!!!

reviews.author: Alicia Wallace
reviews.text: Hands down the best shop in the Pee Dee! Fred is the only person I take my vehicle to for jobs big and small! Great work and service!

reviews.author: Keithmor1
reviews.text: I use Fred’s for service of my fleet lease vehicle. They are always fast and friendly and do great work.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Tamburrino
reviews.text: Fred is awesome! Gets vehicles done in a timely matter and has great communication!!! Highly suggest!

reviews.author: Lindsey Wise
reviews.text: Hands down the best tire shop around.. Fred is an amazing businessman and has the best personality!! Stop in and see him and his amazing crew!!

reviews.author: Gerald Hyatt
reviews.text: Always receive quality work and nice helpful staff everytime i go here. Can get busy at times but the quick service gets you out before long.

reviews.author: Marjorie Butler
reviews.text: First time using this repair shop. I really appreciate being treated like a long standing customer. These people know how to treat their customers.

reviews.author: steve aylward
reviews.text: Yes yes driving down from New York my brakes went, and Fred It was more than willing and able to help me . If anybody ever gets stuck and you can make it here go to this gentleman, don’t go anywhere but here

reviews.author: Samantha Garboden
reviews.text: Such amazing service! We were traveling through, had an unknown problem and they had us come right in. They solved it, explained it and helped us so much!

reviews.author: Phoenix of New Orleans
reviews.text: just wanna give a big shout out to these guys I had 3 flats stuck at a rest stop called told him what happened.... he calls back has tires lined up tow truck on the way ... I'm from southeast Louisiana and had no idea who to call I'm grateful for them thx so much for all yall did to get me back on the road

reviews.author: Joseph Judy
reviews.text: Best tire shop around. Stranded on side of the road and was here in minutes. I highly recommend Fred's!

reviews.author: Corey Humphrey
reviews.text: Fred and his crew have always been there for me any time I have called or stopped by. Best all around.
